safe_cex_exchange::exchange::SharedExcha.reason: Reviewed exchange.rs::SharedExchangeOptions: Clone duplicates the Rc<RefCell<ExchangeOptions>> handle, not its stored configuration. BaseExchange and WsExchangeParent intentionally share this internal owner; snapshot() separately clones an owned view. Mutations through the retained owner remain shared, while an earlier snapshot stays frozen. It carries reusable configuration, not a consumed placement validation token. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/CLAUDE.md#abstract-venue-hooks; this classification is not a deep-copy or decoder-domain claim.

safe_cex_exchange::owned_tasks::OwnedOpe.reason: Reviewed owned_tasks.rs::OwnedOperation: Clone copies the same weak task-registry reference and operation ID. Aliases intentionally share cancellation authority over one existing registration; cancel removes/finishes that same slot once, is_active reads it, and dropping a handle does not cancel or retain the registry. Cloning neither registers/spawns new work nor creates an independent one-use validation token. It is weak reusable cancellation authority, not an owned task or a snapshot. See sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/CANCELLATION_REVIEW.md and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/CLAUDE.md#abstract-venue-hooks; raw decoder/construction obligations remain separate.

safe_cex_exchange::shared_operation::Sha.reason: Reviewed shared_operation.rs::SharedOperation<T>: the compiler-derived Clone is conditional on immediate T: Clone. It retains the same Rc result/waiter state and clones the same weak OwnedOperation handle, so cancellation affects the same work and cloning does not launch or settle another operation. Each wait creates its own registration and clones the settled Result<T,ExchangeError> only after the state borrow ends; payload duplication delegates to T and may retain shared Rc identity. No arbitrary-T/deep-independence or unique validation authority is granted. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/CANCELLATION_REVIEW.md.

safe_cex_exchange::waiters::Waiters.reason: Reviewed waiters.rs::Waiters: Clone retains the same Rc<RefCell<Vec<(Rc<()>,Waker)>>> registration queue. register() creates a fresh registration identity; cloning Waiters itself creates no registration and Registration is not Clone. wake_all drains the one shared queue; Registration Drop removes only its own identity. This is deliberately shared reusable coordination/wake authority, not independent queue snapshots or consumed placement validation. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/CANCELLATION_REVIEW.md.

safe_cex_exchange::proxy_token::ProxyTok.reason: Reviewed proxy_token.rs::ProxyTokenClient: Clone retains the exact Rc host/runtime and Rc<RefCell<State>>, sharing cached bearer token/expiry, callbacks, fetch flight, timer and generation. It does not duplicate a running flight/timer or mint a new credential or one-use validation token. Calls through aliases mutate the same reusable service state; this is not secret isolation or a deep copy. JWT decoding, coercion and source-specific APIs stay independently inventoried/executed. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/CLAUDE.md#abstract-venue-hooks.

safe_cex_exchange::runtime::ExchangeErro.reason: Reviewed runtime.rs::ExchangeErrorOrigin: Clone retains the same Rc<dyn Error>, and PartialEq explicitly compares Rc identity. The inner error need not implement Clone and its interior state, if any, remains shared; error() exposes a borrowed typed-error view. This copies a reusable origin handle, not the underlying error, a validation token, or an independent authority state. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias. ExchangeError conversions and encoded REST response parsing retain separate native decoder obligations.

safe_cex_exchange::websocket::RelayDescr.reason: Reviewed websocket.rs::RelayDescriptor: Clone copies URL and WebSocketConnectionOptions as a reusable reconnect configuration descriptor. Owned protocols/static header maps and scalar options are copied; UpgradeHeaders::Fresh retains the same Rc callback, so no universal deep independence is claimed. SocketState uses cloned descriptors for reconnect/fallback; cloning the descriptor itself creates no socket, task, validation token or transport connection. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/WS_CONTRACT.md; connection/decoder behavior remains independently classified.

safe_cex_exchange::websocket::ResolvedCo.reason: Reviewed websocket.rs::ResolvedConnection (b7be48e605): Clone copies the reviewed RelayDescriptor plus two resolved booleans (relay, reconnecting). DormantSocket retains one resolved connection and clones it on each explicit reconnect, so every activation re-dials from the same immutable start_closed configuration; open_resolved_connection consumes only that copy. Cloning creates no socket, task, generation, validation token or transport connection, and UpgradeHeaders::Fresh retains the descriptor's Rc callback, so no deep independence is claimed. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/WS_CONTRACT.md; connection behavior remains independently classified.

safe_cex_exchange::access_token::AccessT.reason: Reviewed access_token.rs::AccessToken: Clone retains one Rc<RefCell<State>> for current token and refresh/contextual callbacks, clones the optional ProxyTokenClient shared handle, and retains the VirtualClock shared owner. Browser-context flag is copied. The aliases intentionally observe the same credential-service mutations; cloning does not run refresh, duplicate a token flight, or mint one-use validation authority. Contextual credential ownership and JWT/expiry parsing remain separate obligations. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias and sdk-rs/safe-cex-exchange/CLAUDE.md#abstract-venue-hooks.

safe_cex_exchange::cross_trade::CrossTra.reason: Reviewed cross_trade/mod.rs::CrossTradeLoop: Clone retains the same Rc<Cell<bool>> disposed flag and same Rc callback. CrossTradeManager::start/stop mark that shared flag and schedule/retain the original callback; cloning a loop handle alone schedules no new work. run() is a reusable callback operation already callable through &self; clones share its captured configuration/weak manager and stop state rather than manufacturing an independent active loop or validation token. See sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#crosstrade-capability-ownership and sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias.

safe_cex_exchange::js_runtime::promise::.reason: Reviewed promise.rs::Promise: Clone duplicates the Rc<RefCell<State>> handle. Clones intentionally share settlement, waiters and the owned continuation task; they do not clone or restart that task. Promise results are reusable native data and carry no one-use placement or signing authority. This is shared identity, not a frozen snapshot or independent state; sdk-rs/parity/MANIFEST-SPEC.md#owned-snapshot-vs-live-alias.

safe_cex_exchange::js_runtime::library::.reason: Reviewed library.rs::Decimal: derived Clone copies its owned BigInt coefficient and i64 scale for reusable bignumber arithmetic. The private fields carry numeric value data, no consumed nonce, validation witness or task authority. This classifies duplication only; parse/format/arithmetic behavior retains its separate inventory and tests.

Reviewed js_runtime/library.rs::DayjsState: Clone duplicates the wall-clock, utc and local-offset scalar fields and shallow-clones the optional Js offset. The source utc plugin can retain a raw offset value, so reference-valued offsets retain their existing identity; this is not a deep-copy claim. Each dayjs operation constructs a new facade from this reusable state, with no new task, registry or one-use validation authority. tests/js_builtins.rs compares installed-dayjs offset coercions and 420 chains. This private construction classification is not a decoder-domain claim.
